Reference / compression/gzip

compression/gzip#

gzip (RFC 1952): DEFLATE with a header, a CRC-32 and the length; what .gz files and Content-Encoding: gzip hold (#183).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let packed = GzipCompressed(data).bytes();
let data = GzipDecompressed(origin: packed, limit: 10485760).bytes();

Description#

gzip (RFC 1952): DEFLATE with a header, a CRC-32 and the length; what .gz files and Content-Encoding: gzip hold (#183).

A stream goes through the Compressing and Decompressing roles, for example with compression/read:

let packed = CompressedReading(origin: input, compressor: GzipCompressor());

Decompression is bounded: limit is the most bytes it may produce, past which it throws CompressionLimitExceeded; damaged data is InvalidCompressedData.
